'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Peter Tenneson DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Peter Tenneson]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Ottawa = Awatto
* '''Username:''' patmagroin
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
